messages:
Ada Zhou: Hey everyone! I’m Ada, joining SW Eng (inference infra). First day 🎉. I have my laptop but can’t access the dev VPC—getting a timeout on ssh. Any quick pointers?
Liam - IT: Welcome Ada! :wave: I just sent you the MDM invite. For the VPC, can you paste the exact error?
Ada Zhou: Thanks Liam — I get "ssh: connect to host 10.12.34.56 port 22: Operation timed out". I can ping github and external sites fine.
Liam - IT: Hmm—likely missing the SSO network role. I can see you in Okta but not the dev-vpc group. Give me 5, I’ll add the role.
Gwen (People Ops): Welcome Ada! If you need onboarding checklist, here’s the doc: https://redwood.company/onboarding/quickstart (we'll DM the internal version). Lunch tomorrow with the team? :taco:
Ivy (Eng): Hi Ada — I’m on the inference infra team and your buddy for the week. Ping me for any repo access. To test SSH after Liam updates you, try `ssh -v build@jumpbox.redwood.internal`.
Ada Zhou: Thanks Ivy — noted. Also, who do I ask about a Dedicated cluster quota for experiment runs?
Marco (DevEx): Hi! For Dedicated/DV cluster quotas, tag @infra-scheduling in the ticket. Also we have a short guide for running local perf tests: ```bash
./scripts/start_local.sh --gpus 1
```
Liam - IT: You should be in dev-vpc group now, Ada. Try again and paste output if still blocked.
Ada Zhou: That worked! Able to ssh into jumpbox. Huge thank you 🙏. One more small Q — badge access for office 3rd floor?
Gwen (People Ops): I added your badge request. Security will activate it by tomorrow afternoon. Welcome aboard again :confetti_ball:
RecruitBot: Ada Zhou has completed the paperwork checklist — congrats on joining Redwood Inference! :sparkles:
